tree.heading: In general.—
tree.text: The term “museum object” means an object that—

children.text: is eligible to be, or is made part of, a museum, library, or archive collection through a formal procedure, such as accessioning.

tree.heading: Inclusions.—
tree.text: The term “museum object” includes a prehistoric or historic artifact, work of art, book, document, photograph, or natural history specimen.
